    • Pricing
    Go to Dashboard

    SEO & GEO Glossary

    Essential terms for search engine optimization and AI visibility. Your guide to understanding modern search marketing.

    40 terms

    Category

    Translation

    Index

    ABCDEFGIJKLMOPQRSTZ
    A
    AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)AEOGEO & AI Visibility

    The practice of optimizing content to appear as direct answers in AI-powered answer engines, chatbots, and voice assistants.

    Related:GEOQuery Fan-OutAI CitationFeatured SnippetPrompt Tracking
    AI Brand MentionsGEO & AI Visibility

    Instances where an AI assistant references a brand by name in a generated answer, even without linking to the brand's content.

    Related:AI CitationCitation SOVGEOAVIPrompt Tracking
    AI CitationGEO & AI Visibility

    When an AI model references or recommends a specific brand, product, or source in its generated response. Citations are the currency of GEO — they determine whether your brand appears when users ask AI for recommendations.

    Related:GEOAVICitation SOVPrompt TrackingLLMBacklinkE-E-A-TSchema Markup (Structured Data)
    AI CrawlersGEO & AI Visibility

    Automated bots deployed by AI companies to read, index, and retrieve website content for use in training data, search indexes, and real-time AI-generated answers.

    Related:GEOllms.txtRAGAI Citation
    AI Overview (AIO)AIOGEO & AI Visibility

    Google's AI-generated summary that appears at the top of search results, synthesizing information from multiple sources to directly answer user queries.

    Related:SERPGEOFeatured SnippetSEOAI CitationSchema Markup (Structured Data)E-E-A-TAVI
    B
    BacklinkSEO

    A hyperlink on an external website that points to your website. Backlinks serve as "votes of confidence" that signal trust and authority to search engines and AI models, making them one of the most influential ranking and citation factors.

    Related:Domain AuthoritySEOE-E-A-TTopical AuthorityKDGEOAI CitationOrganic TrafficInternal Linking
    C
    Citation RateGEO & AI Visibility

    The percentage of relevant AI-generated answers that explicitly reference or link to your content as a source.

    Related:AI CitationCitation SOVAI Brand MentionsGEOAVI
    Citation SOVGEO & AI Visibility

    The percentage of AI-generated responses in which your brand is cited, compared to competitors, for a set of tracked queries.

    Related:AI CitationAVIKeyword VisibilityGEOPrompt TrackingLLMAIOSchema Markup (Structured Data)
    Content ClusterContent & Optimization

    A content architecture model where a comprehensive pillar page on a broad topic is connected through internal links to multiple cluster pages that cover related subtopics in depth.

    Related:Topical AuthorityInternal LinkingSEOOn-Page SEO
    Content OptimizationContent & Optimization

    The process of improving content to better satisfy search intent, improve search rankings, and increase the likelihood of being cited by AI models.

    Related:SEOGEOSearch IntentE-E-A-TSchema Markup (Structured Data)BacklinkRAGFeatured Snippet
    CTR (Click-Through Rate)CTRSEO

    The percentage of users who click on a specific link or result out of the total number who see it. In SEO, it measures how effectively a search listing attracts clicks.

    Related:SERPSEOOn-Page SEOFeatured SnippetMeta TagsSchema Markup (Structured Data)
    D
    Domain AuthoritySEO

    A third-party score (0–100) predicting how well a website will rank on search engines, based on backlink profile strength. Major variants include Moz DA, Ahrefs DR, and SEMrush Authority Score.

    Related:BacklinkSEOE-E-A-TAVITopical AuthorityKDOrganic TrafficAI Citation
    E
    E-E-A-TContent & Optimization

    Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness — Google's framework for evaluating content quality. Critical for ranking in competitive topics.

    Related:SEODomain AuthorityContent OptimizationBacklinkSchema Markup (Structured Data)AI CitationGEORAG
    F
    Featured SnippetSEO

    A highlighted excerpt from a webpage displayed at the top of Google search results (Position 0), providing a direct answer to the user's query.

    Related:SERPAIOPAASEOGEOSearch IntentSchema Markup (Structured Data)Content OptimizationOn-Page SEOZero-Click Search
    G
    GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)GEOGEO & AI Visibility

    The practice of optimizing content to be cited and referenced by AI-powered search engines and language models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. The AI-era complement to traditional SEO.

    Related:AVIAI CitationCitation SOVLLMSEOPrompt TrackingAIOSchema Markup (Structured Data)
    GEO ScoreAVIGEO & AI Visibility

    A score measuring how visible your brand is inside AI answers — citation rate, mention rate, citation rank, mention rank, mention share and citation share. It makes up 30% of the AVI composite score.

    Related:GEOAI CitationCitation SOVPrompt TrackingDomain AuthorityLLMAIOSEO
    I
    Internal LinkingSEO

    The practice of linking one page of a website to another page on the same website, distributing link equity and helping search engines understand site structure and content hierarchy.

    Related:Topical AuthoritySEOOn-Page SEOBacklinkContent Cluster
    J
    JSON-LDJSON-LDContent & Optimization

    A lightweight data format used to implement structured data (schema markup) on web pages, enabling search engines and AI models to understand page content in a machine-readable way.

    Related:Schema Markup (Structured Data)E-E-A-TSEOGEOOn-Page SEO
    K
    KeywordSEO

    A word or phrase that users type into search engines. Keywords are the foundation of SEO strategy, guiding content creation and optimization efforts.

    Related:Search IntentKDSearch VolumeSERPSEOGEOOrganic TrafficTopical AuthorityCTRInternal Linking
    Keyword Difficulty (KD)KDSEO

    A metric that estimates how difficult it would be to rank on the first page of search results for a given keyword, typically scored from 0 to 100.

    Related:KeywordSearch VolumeBacklinkDomain AuthoritySEOSERPTopical AuthorityOrganic Traffic
    Keyword VisibilityAnalytics & Metrics

    Percentage of tracked keywords where your brand ranks in the top 10 of search results. A SEO-side visibility metric, distinct from GEO Citation SOV.

    Related:Citation SOVSEOGEOTop 10AVIAI CitationPrompt TrackingKeyword
    L
    LLM (Large Language Model)LLMAI & Technology

    An AI model trained on massive text datasets that can understand and generate human-like text. Examples include GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude.

    Related:GEOAI CitationRAGPrompt TrackingAIOCitation SOVAVISchema Markup (Structured Data)
    LLM SEOGEO & AI Visibility

    The practice of optimizing content and brand presence so that Large Language Models retrieve, cite, and recommend your brand in AI-generated answers.

    Related:GEOAEOLLMAI CitationTopical Authority
    llms.txtGEO & AI Visibility

    A standardized markdown file placed at a website's root that tells AI models which content is most important and where to find clean, machine-readable versions of key pages.

    Related:GEOAI CrawlersSchema Markup (Structured Data)RAG
    M
    Meta TagsSEO

    HTML elements in a page's <head> section that provide metadata about the page to search engines and browsers — including the title tag, meta description, robots directives, and Open Graph tags.

    Related:On-Page SEOCTRSERPSEOSchema Markup (Structured Data)
    O
    On-Page SEOSEO

    The practice of optimizing individual web page elements — including content, HTML source code, meta tags, and internal links — to improve search engine rankings and user experience.

    Related:SEOMeta TagsInternal LinkingSchema Markup (Structured Data)CTRTechnical SEOSearch Intent
    Organic TrafficSEO

    Website visitors that come from unpaid search engine results, as opposed to paid ads or direct visits.

    Related:SEOSERPKeywordAVIGEOAIOSearch VolumeSearch IntentZero-Click SearchCTR
    P
    PAA (People Also Ask)PAASEO

    A Google SERP feature displaying expandable related questions with short answer snippets. Appears in 65%+ of searches and serves as a bridge between traditional SEO and AI search optimization.

    Related:SERPFeatured SnippetSearch IntentContent OptimizationQuery Fan-OutGEORAGAI Citation
    Prompt TrackingGEO & AI Visibility

    The systematic monitoring of how AI models respond to specific prompts related to your brand, product, or industry over time.

    Related:GEOAI CitationAVICitation SOVLLMRAGAIOSEO
    Q
    Query Fan-OutGEO & AI Visibility

    The process where AI search engines split a single user question into multiple sub-queries, retrieve data for each, and combine the results into one synthesized answer.

    Related:GEOAIOTopical AuthorityLLMAI Citation
    R
    RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)RAGAI & Technology

    An AI technique that enhances LLM responses by retrieving relevant information from external sources before generating an answer, improving accuracy and recency.

    Related:LLMAI CitationGEOAIOSchema Markup (Structured Data)Prompt TrackingE-E-A-TSEO
    S
    Schema Markup (Structured Data)Content & Optimization

    A standardized vocabulary (JSON-LD) added to HTML that helps search engines and AI models understand page content semantically. Enables rich results in SERPs and increases the likelihood of AI citations.

    Related:SEOSERPFeatured SnippetGEOAI CitationE-E-A-TRAGAI Crawlers
    Search IntentSEO

    The underlying purpose behind a search query: whether the user wants information, navigation, comparison, or to make a purchase.

    Related:KeywordSERPSEOGEOContent OptimizationAI CitationFeatured SnippetSearch VolumeZero-Click Search
    Search VolumeSEO

    The average number of times a keyword is searched per month. It indicates the potential traffic a keyword can drive.

    Related:KeywordKDSearch IntentSERPSEOOrganic TrafficAIO
    SEO (Search Engine Optimization)SEOSEO

    The practice of optimizing websites and content to rank higher in search engine results pages (SERPs), increasing organic visibility and traffic.

    Related:SERPKeywordOrganic TrafficGEOTopical AuthorityBacklinkSearch IntentOn-Page SEOTechnical SEOCTRMeta Tags
    SERP (Search Engine Results Page)SERPSEO

    The page displayed by a search engine in response to a query. Modern SERPs include organic results, featured snippets, AI overviews, and other rich features.

    Related:SEOGEOAIOFeatured SnippetPAASearch IntentOrganic TrafficSchema Markup (Structured Data)CTRZero-Click Search
    T
    Technical SEOSEO

    The optimization of a website's technical infrastructure — including crawlability, indexing, site speed, mobile-friendliness, and security — to help search engines access, understand, and rank content effectively.

    Related:SEOOn-Page SEOSchema Markup (Structured Data)JSON-LDAI Crawlersllms.txt
    Top 10Analytics & Metrics

    The percentage of tracked keywords for which your pages rank in the top 10 search results. A key indicator of overall SEO performance.

    Related:SEOKeywordSERPKeyword VisibilityAIOAVIContent OptimizationBacklink
    Topical AuthorityGEO & AI Visibility

    The perceived expertise and trustworthiness a brand has on a specific subject, as evaluated by both search engines and AI models.

    Related:GEOQuery Fan-OutAI CitationE-E-A-TBacklink
    Z
    Zero-Click SearchSEO

    A search query that ends without the user clicking on any result, because the answer is provided directly on the search results page — via AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, or Knowledge Panels.

    Related:SEOSERPAIOGEOFeatured Snippet

AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)AEOGEO & AI VisibilityThe practice of optimizing content to appear as direct answers in AI-powered answer engines, chatbots, and voice assistants.Related:GEOQuery Fan-OutAI CitationFeatured SnippetPrompt Tracking

AI Brand MentionsGEO & AI VisibilityInstances where an AI assistant references a brand by name in a generated answer, even without linking to the brand's content.Related:AI CitationCitation SOVGEOAVIPrompt Tracking

AI CitationGEO & AI VisibilityWhen an AI model references or recommends a specific brand, product, or source in its generated response. Citations are the currency of GEO — they determine whether your brand appears when users ask AI for recommendations.Related:GEOAVICitation SOVPrompt TrackingLLMBacklinkE-E-A-TSchema Markup (Structured Data)

AI CrawlersGEO & AI VisibilityAutomated bots deployed by AI companies to read, index, and retrieve website content for use in training data, search indexes, and real-time AI-generated answers.Related:GEOllms.txtRAGAI Citation

AI Overview (AIO)AIOGEO & AI VisibilityGoogle's AI-generated summary that appears at the top of search results, synthesizing information from multiple sources to directly answer user queries.Related:SERPGEOFeatured SnippetSEOAI CitationSchema Markup (Structured Data)E-E-A-TAVI

BacklinkSEOA hyperlink on an external website that points to your website. Backlinks serve as "votes of confidence" that signal trust and authority to search engines and AI models, making them one of the most influential ranking and citation factors.Related:Domain AuthoritySEOE-E-A-TTopical AuthorityKDGEOAI CitationOrganic TrafficInternal Linking
Citation RateGEO & AI VisibilityThe percentage of relevant AI-generated answers that explicitly reference or link to your content as a source.Related:AI CitationCitation SOVAI Brand MentionsGEOAVI

Citation SOVGEO & AI VisibilityThe percentage of AI-generated responses in which your brand is cited, compared to competitors, for a set of tracked queries.Related:AI CitationAVIKeyword VisibilityGEOPrompt TrackingLLMAIOSchema Markup (Structured Data)

Content ClusterContent & OptimizationA content architecture model where a comprehensive pillar page on a broad topic is connected through internal links to multiple cluster pages that cover related subtopics in depth.Related:Topical AuthorityInternal LinkingSEOOn-Page SEO

Content OptimizationContent & OptimizationThe process of improving content to better satisfy search intent, improve search rankings, and increase the likelihood of being cited by AI models.Related:SEOGEOSearch IntentE-E-A-TSchema Markup (Structured Data)BacklinkRAGFeatured Snippet

CTR (Click-Through Rate)CTRSEOThe percentage of users who click on a specific link or result out of the total number who see it. In SEO, it measures how effectively a search listing attracts clicks.Related:SERPSEOOn-Page SEOFeatured SnippetMeta TagsSchema Markup (Structured Data)

Domain AuthoritySEOA third-party score (0–100) predicting how well a website will rank on search engines, based on backlink profile strength. Major variants include Moz DA, Ahrefs DR, and SEMrush Authority Score.Related:BacklinkSEOE-E-A-TAVITopical AuthorityKDOrganic TrafficAI Citation

E-E-A-TContent & OptimizationExperience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness — Google's framework for evaluating content quality. Critical for ranking in competitive topics.Related:SEODomain AuthorityContent OptimizationBacklinkSchema Markup (Structured Data)AI CitationGEORAG

Featured SnippetSEOA highlighted excerpt from a webpage displayed at the top of Google search results (Position 0), providing a direct answer to the user's query.Related:SERPAIOPAASEOGEOSearch IntentSchema Markup (Structured Data)Content OptimizationOn-Page SEOZero-Click Search

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)GEOGEO & AI VisibilityThe practice of optimizing content to be cited and referenced by AI-powered search engines and language models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. The AI-era complement to traditional SEO.Related:AVIAI CitationCitation SOVLLMSEOPrompt TrackingAIOSchema Markup (Structured Data)

GEO ScoreAVIGEO & AI VisibilityA score measuring how visible your brand is inside AI answers — citation rate, mention rate, citation rank, mention rank, mention share and citation share. It makes up 30% of the AVI composite score.Related:GEOAI CitationCitation SOVPrompt TrackingDomain AuthorityLLMAIOSEO

Internal LinkingSEOThe practice of linking one page of a website to another page on the same website, distributing link equity and helping search engines understand site structure and content hierarchy.Related:Topical AuthoritySEOOn-Page SEOBacklinkContent Cluster

JSON-LDJSON-LDContent & OptimizationA lightweight data format used to implement structured data (schema markup) on web pages, enabling search engines and AI models to understand page content in a machine-readable way.Related:Schema Markup (Structured Data)E-E-A-TSEOGEOOn-Page SEO

KeywordSEOA word or phrase that users type into search engines. Keywords are the foundation of SEO strategy, guiding content creation and optimization efforts.Related:Search IntentKDSearch VolumeSERPSEOGEOOrganic TrafficTopical AuthorityCTRInternal Linking

Keyword Difficulty (KD)KDSEOA metric that estimates how difficult it would be to rank on the first page of search results for a given keyword, typically scored from 0 to 100.Related:KeywordSearch VolumeBacklinkDomain AuthoritySEOSERPTopical AuthorityOrganic Traffic

Keyword VisibilityAnalytics & MetricsPercentage of tracked keywords where your brand ranks in the top 10 of search results. A SEO-side visibility metric, distinct from GEO Citation SOV.Related:Citation SOVSEOGEOTop 10AVIAI CitationPrompt TrackingKeyword

LLM (Large Language Model)LLMAI & TechnologyAn AI model trained on massive text datasets that can understand and generate human-like text. Examples include GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude.Related:GEOAI CitationRAGPrompt TrackingAIOCitation SOVAVISchema Markup (Structured Data)

LLM SEOGEO & AI VisibilityThe practice of optimizing content and brand presence so that Large Language Models retrieve, cite, and recommend your brand in AI-generated answers.Related:GEOAEOLLMAI CitationTopical Authority

llms.txtGEO & AI VisibilityA standardized markdown file placed at a website's root that tells AI models which content is most important and where to find clean, machine-readable versions of key pages.Related:GEOAI CrawlersSchema Markup (Structured Data)RAG

Meta TagsSEOHTML elements in a page's <head> section that provide metadata about the page to search engines and browsers — including the title tag, meta description, robots directives, and Open Graph tags.Related:On-Page SEOCTRSERPSEOSchema Markup (Structured Data)

On-Page SEOSEOThe practice of optimizing individual web page elements — including content, HTML source code, meta tags, and internal links — to improve search engine rankings and user experience.Related:SEOMeta TagsInternal LinkingSchema Markup (Structured Data)CTRTechnical SEOSearch Intent
Organic TrafficSEOWebsite visitors that come from unpaid search engine results, as opposed to paid ads or direct visits.Related:SEOSERPKeywordAVIGEOAIOSearch VolumeSearch IntentZero-Click SearchCTR

PAA (People Also Ask)PAASEOA Google SERP feature displaying expandable related questions with short answer snippets. Appears in 65%+ of searches and serves as a bridge between traditional SEO and AI search optimization.Related:SERPFeatured SnippetSearch IntentContent OptimizationQuery Fan-OutGEORAGAI Citation

Prompt TrackingGEO & AI VisibilityThe systematic monitoring of how AI models respond to specific prompts related to your brand, product, or industry over time.Related:GEOAI CitationAVICitation SOVLLMRAGAIOSEO

Query Fan-OutGEO & AI VisibilityThe process where AI search engines split a single user question into multiple sub-queries, retrieve data for each, and combine the results into one synthesized answer.Related:GEOAIOTopical AuthorityLLMAI Citation

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)RAGAI & TechnologyAn AI technique that enhances LLM responses by retrieving relevant information from external sources before generating an answer, improving accuracy and recency.Related:LLMAI CitationGEOAIOSchema Markup (Structured Data)Prompt TrackingE-E-A-TSEO

Schema Markup (Structured Data)Content & OptimizationA standardized vocabulary (JSON-LD) added to HTML that helps search engines and AI models understand page content semantically. Enables rich results in SERPs and increases the likelihood of AI citations.Related:SEOSERPFeatured SnippetGEOAI CitationE-E-A-TRAGAI Crawlers

Search IntentSEOThe underlying purpose behind a search query: whether the user wants information, navigation, comparison, or to make a purchase.Related:KeywordSERPSEOGEOContent OptimizationAI CitationFeatured SnippetSearch VolumeZero-Click Search
Search VolumeSEOThe average number of times a keyword is searched per month. It indicates the potential traffic a keyword can drive.Related:KeywordKDSearch IntentSERPSEOOrganic TrafficAIO

SEO (Search Engine Optimization)SEOSEOThe practice of optimizing websites and content to rank higher in search engine results pages (SERPs), increasing organic visibility and traffic.Related:SERPKeywordOrganic TrafficGEOTopical AuthorityBacklinkSearch IntentOn-Page SEOTechnical SEOCTRMeta Tags

SERP (Search Engine Results Page)SERPSEOThe page displayed by a search engine in response to a query. Modern SERPs include organic results, featured snippets, AI overviews, and other rich features.Related:SEOGEOAIOFeatured SnippetPAASearch IntentOrganic TrafficSchema Markup (Structured Data)CTRZero-Click Search

Technical SEOSEOThe optimization of a website's technical infrastructure — including crawlability, indexing, site speed, mobile-friendliness, and security — to help search engines access, understand, and rank content effectively.Related:SEOOn-Page SEOSchema Markup (Structured Data)JSON-LDAI Crawlersllms.txt

Top 10Analytics & MetricsThe percentage of tracked keywords for which your pages rank in the top 10 search results. A key indicator of overall SEO performance.Related:SEOKeywordSERPKeyword VisibilityAIOAVIContent OptimizationBacklink

Topical AuthorityGEO & AI VisibilityThe perceived expertise and trustworthiness a brand has on a specific subject, as evaluated by both search engines and AI models.Related:GEOQuery Fan-OutAI CitationE-E-A-TBacklink

Zero-Click SearchSEOA search query that ends without the user clicking on any result, because the answer is provided directly on the search results page — via AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, or Knowledge Panels.Related:SEOSERPAIOGEOFeatured Snippet
